Name: Sandra - A Manipulative New NPC (Marriageable) Safe Edition
Author: wxunlimited
Description:
[img width=411]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/54216/54216-1792576509-1033232734.png[/img]

[b]The Cunning Guest[/b] is a story mod for Stardew Valley 1.6: Sandra, your grandfather's "long-lost step-aunt", moves into your farmhouse with a worn suitcase and a plan to take your farm.
Play it naive and she wins. Gather evidence and expose her at a Land Transfer Hearing in front of the whole town. Or stay patient, kind but not foolish, and you may find the woman behind the mask in a secret True Ending most players never see.
[list]
[*]110+ cutscenes, about 3,600 lines of dialogue, 28 letters and 8 festival appearances[/*]
[*]A hidden Suspicion gauge and a Scheme meter that counts down to the Hearing[/*]
[*]Everyday sabotage you can switch off: missing gold, "watered" crops left dry, rumours in town[/*]
[*]A night menu: cook together, dates, romantic dinners, talks, and trying to catch her off guard[/*]
[*]Four standard endings, a secret True Ending, and 21 post-ending romance evenings[/*]
[*]16 full-size portraits and a detailed sprite at villager height, with blinking and a daily routine[/*]
[/list]A drama and dark comedy. All content is non-explicit; Sandra is an adult, and her schemes are fraud, forgery and manipulation.

[heading]Walkthrough[/heading]
The story runs on hearts with Sandra: raise them with talk and gifts, and each tier unlocks the next event. One story scene plays per day at most.
Act 1: The guest (arrival to 3 hearts)
[list=1]
[*][b]The Doorstep Scheme[/b] — after Spring 5, sunny morning, farm porch. Let her in; a house tour and a 3-day guest arc follow.[/*]
[*][b]The Grocery Tab[/b] (1 heart) — Pierre's, 9 AM–5 PM. Luxury goods charged to "the farm account".[/*]
[*][b]The Saloon Sympathy Act[/b] (2 hearts) — Saloon, 4–7 PM.[/*]
[*][b]The Family Tree[/b] (3 hearts) — near Lewis's house, 9 AM–4 PM. Proves she is no relation; dates and romance unlock after it.[/*]
[*][b]The Borrowed Necklace[/b] (3 hearts) — town square, noon–3 PM. Gives evidence 1: [b]Ruby Necklace Appraisal[/b]. Don't call her out in public if you want the True Ending.[/*]
[*][b]Talking to a Stranger[/b] (3 hearts) — the farm at dusk, 30% per day, at Grandpa's shrine.[/*]
[/list]Act 2: The scheme (4–6 hearts)
[list=1]
[*][b]Midnight Rummaging[/b] (4) — farmhouse after 11 PM.[/*]
[*][b]Marnie's Warning[/b] (4) — Marnie's ranch. You get the [b]Detective's Notebook[/b] (lost it? Willy sells a spare). Suspicion is now visible.[/*]
[*][b]One Eye Open[/b] (4) — the mountain at night; Linus becomes a witness.[/*]
[*][b]Midnight Gaslighting[/b] and [b]Ashes in the Fireplace[/b] (5) — on waking. Evidence: [b]Torn Letter[/b].[/*]
[*][b]The Town Council Warning[/b] (6) — near Lewis's house, 10 AM–3 PM. The [b]Hearing[/b] is scheduled and a countdown appears under the clock (default Winter 15, Year 2).[/*]
[*][b]Practice Makes Perfect[/b] (6) — on waking. Evidence: [b]Forged Deed Draft[/b].[/*]
[/list]Act 3: The case (7–8 hearts)
[list=1]
[*][b]The Poisoned Well[/b] (7) — the farm, Monday morning. Evidence: [b]Unmarked Vial[/b].[/*]
[*][b]The Second Visitor[/b] (7) — bus stop. Delia Marsh, a past victim, becomes a witness.[/*]
[*][b]Professional Courtesy[/b] (7) — town square. Sandra helps you expose a sloppier con man.[/*]
[*][b]The Saloon Backroom Rendezvous[/b] (7–8, Saloon 8–11 PM) — or [b]The Backroom Deal[/b] with romance off.[/*]
[*][b]Clint's Redemption[/b] — after Clint's bad morning, visit his shop. Evidence: [b]Saloon Receipt[/b]; Clint becomes a witness.[/*]
[*][b]The Aliases[/b] — Museum, once you hold 3+ evidence. Her other names come out.[/*]
[/list]Act 4: The Hearing
On the Hearing date, go to the Community Center steps. Lewis asks five questions; present evidence in this order:
[list=1]
[*]Ruby Necklace Appraisal (what she [b]took[/b])[/*]
[*]Saloon Receipt (who she [b]paid[/b])[/*]
[*]Unmarked Vial (what she [b]staged[/b])[/*]
[*]Torn Letter (who she [b]really is[/b])[/*]
[*]Forged Deed Draft (what she [b]forged[/b])[/*]
[/list]Each correct answer and each witness cracks her composure. Possible witnesses: Marnie, Gunther, Abigail, Demetrius, Gus (rumour cleared), Clint (redeemed), Haley (necklace returned), Delia, Linus.
[table][tr][th]Ending[/th]
[th]How you get it[/th]
[th]What happens[/th]
[/tr]
[tr][td]Exposed[/td]
[td]composure 25 or lower[/td]
[td]she leaves the valley; you get [i]Sandra's Notebook[/i][/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td]Redemption (rare)[/td]
[td]Exposed + Fairy Rose given + 3 key kind choices + Suspicion under 50 at the 7-heart event[/td]
[td]she confesses, leaves a letter, and stops[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td]Stalemate[/td]
[td]composure 60 or lower[/td]
[td]Hearing delayed 14 days; Scheme drops to 70[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td]Eviction[/td]
[td]she stays composed with Scheme 85+, or Scheme hits 100[/td]
[td]you lose the farm (Rewind mode lets you retry)[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]Secret: The Woman Behind the Mask
The game never tells you when you lose this path; type
[code]sandra_trueending_debug[/code]in the SMAPI console to check. You need all of these:
[list]
[*]Scheme never above 60[/*]
[*]Never humiliate her in public (3-heart call-out, public confrontation in [i]The Aliases[/i], exposing her at the Hearing)[/*]
[*]Suspicion between 30 and 70 at the 5-, 6- and 7-heart events[/*]
[*]Fairy Rose on her birthday (Fall 14)[/*]
[*]Pearl within 7 days of the 7-heart event[/*]
[*]Handwritten Letter in winter after the 6-heart event (Writing Desk from Robin: 1 Squid Ink + 3 Fiber)[/*]
[*]Rabbit's Foot within 7 days of [i]The Aliases[/i][/*]
[*]Prismatic Shard any time after the 8-heart event[/*]
[*]Choose [b]Defiant[/b] at the 8-heart event, then finish Clint's redemption kindly[/*]
[*]Catch the three quiet moments: winter night humming at the window (5% on entering the house), spring rain on the porch (bring tea or coffee), alone at the Moonlight Jellies[/*]
[*]10 hearts, dating or married, never divorced[/*]
[*]Year 3 or later, and 112+ days after [i]The Aliases[/i][/*]
[*]Pass the final test in [i]The Offer[/i][/*]
[/list]If it all holds, Sandra asks Lewis to postpone the Hearing and six final scenes play. Afterwards she stays, warm but still sharp, "Spend the evening" unlocks, and you earn the hidden achievement [b]The One Mark She Couldn't Rob[/b].
[heading]Guide[/heading]
The two hidden numbers
[list]
[*][b]Suspicion (0–100)[/b] — how clearly you see through her: Trusting 0–24, Uneasy 25–49, Wary 50–74, Certain 75–100. It changes her lines, gift reactions and how careful she is. The Detective's Notebook shows it.[/*]
[*][b]Scheme (0–100)[/b] — how close she is to the farm. It rises daily (faster when you trust her) and from naive choices; evidence and a Defiant stance slow it. It caps at 75 until the 6-heart event. At 100 you get the Eviction ending.[/*]
[/list]Daily life
[list]
[*][b]Mornings:[/b] she waits by the kitchen with breakfast, a hint, or a "chore" note. Beware [b]Sandra's Special[/b]: same name and icon as the real dish, but a small debuff.[/*]
[*][b]Money drain:[/b] 50–300g can vanish with a sweet note. Daily cap; she never takes you below 500g.[/*]
[*][b]Crop "help":[/b] up to 5% of watered crops stay dry.[/*]
[*][b]Rumours:[/b] Haley, Gus, Clint, Pam or Lewis may like you less. Talk to them or give a gift to fix it. Abigail, Marnie, Linus and Demetrius see through her early.[/*]
[*][b]Her home:[/b] dialogue changes with your house. Starter cabin: she teases it, respects Grandpa, and cooks basic food. Kitchen upgrade: complex dishes and praise. Double bed: "you're so naughty".[/*]
[/list][b]Loved gifts:[/b] Diamond, Gold Bar, Iridium Bar, Salmon Dinner, Lobster Bisque, Wine, Fairy Rose, Pearl, Prismatic Shard, Rabbit’s Foot, Handwritten Letter.
[b]Liked gifts:[/b] all gems, all flowers, Coffee.
[b]Disliked gifts:[/b] Daffodil, Leek, Wood.
[b]Hated gifts:[/b] Trash, Stone. Everything else is neutral.
Fairy Rose, Pearl, Handwritten Letter, Rabbit’s Foot and Prismatic Shard also matter for the secret True Ending, so each should be given on its own occasion.
[b]Daily schedule:[/b] she has no fixed timetable. The mod plans her day each morning.
[table][tr][th]Time[/th]
[th]Where she is[/th]
[/tr]
[tr][td]6:00–9:00 AM[/td]
[td]at home[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td]9:00 AM–12:00 PM[/td]
[td]an outing[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td]12:00–1:00 PM[/td]
[td]at home[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td]1:00–5:30 PM[/td]
[td]an outing[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td]5:30 PM onward[/td]
[td]at home[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]Each outing is the farm, town or home. On a sunny day it’s roughly 55% farm, 25% town and 20% home. When it’s cold the split is 35% farm, 15% town and 50% home. On rainy days and festival days she stays home. With Stardew Valley Expanded installed she skips town outings.
[list]
[*][b]At home[/b], she:
[list]
[*]cooks (more often around mealtimes);[/*]
[*]has tea;[/*]
[*]reads (more in the evening);[/*]
[*]dusts (mostly before 1 PM);[/*]
[*]looks out the window;[/*]
[*]watches TV if you have one;[/*]
[*]paces;[/*]
[*]dozes in an armchair.[/*]
[/list][/*]
[*][b]On the farm[/b], she:
[list]
[*]sips tea on the porch;[/*]
[*]visits Grandpa’s shrine;[/*]
[*]crouches over your crops;[/*]
[*]feeds the animals if you have a coop or barn;[/*]
[*]checks the mailbox;[/*]
[*]looks at the shipping bin;[/*]
[*]visits the well;[/*]
[*]pets your pet;[/*]
[*]strolls around the yard.[/*]
[/list][/*]
[*][b]In town[/b], she shops at Pierre’s, stands in the square, or strolls.[/*]
[/list]The night menu (talk to her at home after 8 PM)
[table][tr][th]Option[/th]
[th]Unlocks[/th]
[th]What it does[/th]
[/tr]
[tr][td]Cook dinner together[/td]
[td]always[/td]
[td]pick an ingredient; you get the dish, a charred one, or Sandra's Special[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td]Ask her on a date[/td]
[td]4 hearts + [i]The Family Tree[/i][/td]
[td]river, stars, Saloon, beach, movie theater, festival booths[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td]Plan a romantic dinner[/td]
[td]6 hearts + dating or married[/td]
[td]pick four courses and a setting; Act 4 hides a test[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td]Just talk[/td]
[td]always[/td]
[td]small talk, her past, or the deed[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td]Approach her[/td]
[td]until the True Ending[/td]
[td]try to catch her off guard; usually she mocks you. Three nights running and she's "not in the mood"[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td]Spend the evening[/td]
[td]after the True Ending[/td]
[td]21 romance scenes[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]Each option has a 2-day cooldown and there's a nightly limit. Listen for slip-ups: about 8% of scenes have a line she shouldn't have said.
Tips
[list]
[*]Raise hearts steadily; story events need both hearts and the right place and time.[/*]
[*]Keep your Suspicion [b]Uneasy or Wary[/b]. Too trusting feeds the Scheme; too certain locks the True Ending.[/*]
[*]Clear rumours and help Clint early: every witness counts at the Hearing.[/*]
[*]Keep evidence items; you can't present what you sold.[/*]
[*]To see the True Ending, never pick the humiliating public options, even when they're tempting.[/*]
[/list]Settings (GMCM or config.json)

[/table][b][size=5]Major Features & Additions[/size][/b]
[list]
[*][b]Sandra's Spouse Room:[/b] After marriage, the normal farmhouse spouse-room slot will feature Sandra's dedicated 6x9 room, complete with red wallpaper, a bookcase, writing table, plant, and burgundy rug. The room applies automatically upon reloading the farmhouse post-marriage.[/*]
[*][b]Event Archive Integration:[/b] Relive your favorite moments. The mod now exposes 115 scenes across 13 locations through
[code]Data/Events[/code]Compatible with Event Archive 1.2.0, this provides read-only previews of past scenes based on your current save's conditional branches.[/*]
[*][b]SVE Town Outings:[/b] With Stardew Valley Expanded installed, Sandra can now choose town outings again. Her existing weather, season, story, and festival rules still apply, utilizing the actual bus-stop warps and standard NPC pathfinding.[/*]
[*][b]Dynamic Wardrobe Transitions:[/b] Sandra features 18 outfits (seasonal, indoor/outdoor winter, beachwear, 8 festival looks, and 4 deterministic night outfits). By default, she changes at 21:00 with a smooth 650ms fade, performing zero-impact background texture uploads (maximum 15.2 MiB cache) to maintain game performance.[/*]
[/list]FAQ
[list]
[*][b]She never arrived.[/b] It must be after Spring 5 and sunny; walk onto your porch in the morning.[/*]
[*][b]Is it compatible with SVE / Ridgeside?[/b] Yes.[/*]
[*][b]Can I check my progress?[/b] Open the Detective's Notebook, or use
[code]sandra_trueending_debug[/code]in the SMAPI console.[/*]
[*][b]Multiplayer?[/b] The story runs on the host; farmhands see the host's story.[/*]
[/list][img width=597]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/54216/54216-1792644632-1696147063.jpg[/img]
